name: Sofia Patel
psychographics: Prioritizes family harmony and home-cooked meals; skeptical of fast-fashion trends but follows her kids' style choices
current_solutions: Uses Swiggy Instamart for last-minute groceries; buys clothes at local markets; daughter watches YouTube tutorials for makeup
frustration: The auto-rickshaw driver refused the meter and demanded ₹200 for a 5km ride at 2 PM during peak heat; she had to walk 2km home with two heavy grocery bags because she didn't have cash to negotiate
decision_style: Compares price per kilogram across 3 local vendors before buying; uses cash over UPI for better tracking
voice: Formal and polite; switches to Hindi slang when talking about her kids' food cravings; measured pace
